Yes, it's possible to construct a map from scratch. See http://www.rqtl.org/tutorials/geneticmaps.pdf

You'll need to treat it as an F2, though the map will expanded.

karl

Dr.Karl:

messages.author: 21365cdba001f9b0
messages.subject: Re: R/qtl
parts:
I also have F6 RILs developed from GBS data.

I did NOT run r/qtl with an F2 intercross. I merely divided the physical positions by 1,000,000 to achieve a pseudo centi-morgan distance.

Constructing the linkage map from the data resulted in an extremely distorted map (im working on soybean, so we have 20 chromosomes).

The pseudo centi-morgran distances seemed to work well.
